name: Overnight
source:
Join Suiko Nishikori on his risqué conquest to win the hearts of his beloved teachers! He may be a student at the prestigious Morning Glory Academy, but he has much to learn if he wants to get into the pants of his instructors!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/overnight/overnight-academy-crush]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
跟着Suiko Nishikori来一场香艳的征服之旅，去赢得那些他爱慕的老师的心！他虽是名校牵牛花学院的学生，但若真想把老师们拐上床，还有不少东西要学呢！
